req.title: Redirect-to rejects invalid status code
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 400 when /redirect-to receives a status_code outside the 300-399 range.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the /redirect-to endpoint should return a 400 status code when the status_code parameter is outside the 300-399 range. This behavior needs to be validated through positive, negative, and boundary tests to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_redirect_to_valid_status_code
actions: Send a GET request to /redirect-to with a valid status_code within 300-399.
expected: The response status code should match the provided status_code.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/redirect-to?url=http://example.com&status_code=302')
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Location'] == b'http://example.com'

tests.name: test_redirect_to_invalid_status_code
actions: Send a GET request to /redirect-to with an invalid status_code outside 300-399.
expected: The response status code should be 400.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/redirect-to?url=http://example.com&status_code=200')
assert response.status_code == 400

tests.name: test_redirect_to_boundary_status_code
actions: Send a GET request to /redirect-to with a boundary status_code of 299 and 400.
expected: The response status code should be 400 for both cases.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response_299 = client.get('/redirect-to?url=http://example.com&status_code=299')
assert response_299.status_code == 400
response_400 = client.get('/redirect-to?url=http://example.com&status_code=400')
assert response_400.status_code == 400
